name: g_hidPadButtonMasks
comment: Table of 24 32-bit hardware button masks for standard 3DS buttons (indices 0..15) and extended Circle Pad Pro / New 3DS controls (indices 16..23). Read by Input_UpdatePadState to translate raw CTR-SDK HID bitmasks into engine button flags.
evidence: Read in .rodata at 0x007354FC by Input_UpdatePadState (0x00108A00) via literal 0x00108BF8 in a loop over 16 (standard 3DS) or 24 (New 3DS/Circle Pad Pro) entries; array elements match standard CTR-SDK HID button bit constants (D-Pad, C-Stick, Start/Select, A/B/X/Y, L/R, ZL/ZR, Circle Pad) mapped to sequential bit indices 0..23.

name: g_padDeviceInitGuard
comment: Call-once static initialization guard (__cxa_guard) in .data for the global circle pad input device object at 0x007E3058. Checked and acquired by Input_Initialize via 0x0010009C.
evidence: Located in .data at 0x007AE728, read and acquired via call-once guard function 0x0010009C by Input_Initialize (0x00105044) via literal 0x0010519C before constructing the pad input device object at 0x007E3058 via 0x001072C0.

name: g_buttonSnapshotInitGuard
comment: Call-once static initialization guard (__cxa_guard) in .data for the global button and touch snapshot state record at 0x007E3040. Checked and acquired by Input_Initialize via 0x0010009C.
evidence: Located in .data at 0x007AE72C, read and acquired via call-once guard function 0x0010009C by Input_Initialize (0x00105044) via literal 0x00105190 before constructing the button and touch snapshot record at 0x007E3040 via 0x001072B0.

name: g_buttonMappingTable
comment: Mapping table of 19 32-bit button masks used by Input_UpdateButtonMasks to translate input snapshot states into engine button flags. Slots 4..7 are zero because directional inputs for those slots are computed from analog stick threshold floats.
evidence: 19-entry .data table of 32-bit bitmasks indexed by Input_UpdateButtonMasks (0x00108878) via literal 0x001089F8; maps button snapshot masks to engine button bits 0..18, with slots 4..7 zeroed out because directional bits 4..7 are evaluated from analog stick axis floats.

name: g_globalTouchState
comment: Global 24-byte touch panel and button snapshot state record in .bss. Constructed in Input_Initialize under guard g_buttonSnapshotInitGuard; updated by Input_UpdateButtonMasks and Input_ReadTouchState.
evidence: 24-byte (.bss) record from 0x007E3040 to 0x007E3058, constructed in Input_Initialize (0x00105044) under guard 0x007AE72C; holds touch panel sampler state (vtable at +0x0, flags at +0xA, +0xB, previous raw touch coordinate/state at +0x2) passed to Input_UpdateButtonMasks (0x00108878) and Input_ReadTouchState (0x0010C1C8).

name: g_globalPadSnapshot
comment: Global pad and analog stick snapshot object in .bss. Constructed in Input_Initialize under guard g_padDeviceInitGuard with vtable 0x0078110C; holds circle pad calibration, previous digital button states, and raw hardware buffers passed to Input_UpdatePadState and Input_ReadPadState.
evidence: Constructed in .bss at 0x007E3058 by 0x001072C0 under call-once guard 0x007AE728 in Input_Initialize (0x00105044); virtual destructor registered via atexit. Object contains vtable 0x0078110C, two stick sub-objects at +0x8 and +0x2C, previous button state at +0x54, raw pad buffer at +0x58, and init flag at +0x98. Passed as pad snapshot parameter to Input_UpdatePadState (0x00108A00) and sampled by Input_ReadPadState (0x0010C2D4).

name: g_rawTouchSampleBuffer
comment: Raw 12-byte touch panel hardware sample buffer in .bss. Populated by service query 0x001148F0 in Input_ReadTouchState with raw touch coordinates, status halfword, and signed delta/pressure bytes.
evidence: 12-byte .bss buffer at 0x007F25CC passed to 0x001148F0 via literal 0x0010C2D0 in Input_ReadTouchState (0x0010C1C8); receives raw 3DS HID touch hardware entry: 3 halfwords at +0x0/+0x2/+0x4 (touch x/y/status) and 4 signed bytes at +0x6/+0x7/+0x8/+0x9 (coordinate delta and pressure values scaled by 0x00114798).
